intent: Restore effective full-history secret scanning with default rules and exact, reviewed historical false-positive dispositions; prove a planted finding makes CI fail.

reasons.evidence: The owned diff changes the hosted Gitleaks workflow and its security gate.
The completed batch pushes dev and observes hosted CI.

invariants: Default Gitleaks rules remain active; no broad tests path exclusion or rule disablement hides a new candidate.
Only the ten individually reviewed historical findings may be ignored, by exact fingerprint and with their redacted dispositions on record.
A disposable-history planted secret makes the same configured scanner exit nonzero without exposing a secret in logs.
Unresolved expired alerts and scanner-versus-Git patch-count differences remain explicitly unresolved.
rollback: Revert the workflow, config, exact-fingerprint ignore list and oracle together only if a replacement strict scan continues to catch the planted finding; retain the redacted history evidence.
verify_line: A disposable-history planted secret makes the configured Gitleaks job exit nonzero; strict redacted scans record scanner version, ref coverage and every historical candidate, and hosted push plus PR scan jobs pass after remediation.
oracle_provenance: Red-first commit fc2d2bd8 failed all three tests in tests/unit/t0180-secret-scan-config.test.ts before implementation. Independent R2 reviewer Pauli found scanner-order and Git-traversal gaps; a different author added the separate tests/unit/t0180-workflow-order-amendment.test.ts, red at four of four in d8f8dc68, SHA-256 2C7CA183E200BB57915264AF8118A0A8D987277F4D5B93C03335CCBFC38507FD. The original three-test file and names remain unchanged. The scanner's disposable-repository canary supplies a behavioural check.
approval: The operator approved the complete Phase 2 plan on 2026-09-28 and authorised prerelease T-0180–T-0187; Q-011 still gates structural work on the operator's rc.1 and v1.0.0 release.
review: Independent R2 reviewer Pauli verified the ten exact fingerprints and no broad path exclusion, and found the initial canary-before-scanner ordering, explicit Git log option and ambient checkout credentials. The workflow now runs both scanner steps before the canary, retains default traversal, and uses a read-only token without persisted checkout credentials. The separate four-case oracle amendment was authored by Pauli and committed red before the repair.
verification: The final byte-identical isolated t0158-sweep checkout passed all ten gate steps by exit code with unchanged tree SHA-256 6814b5222d272f603b3de87508fe9c39f5164bcd3d07f6af831ede355adc18ff: lint, TypeScript, 756 Jest suites (7,335 passed, four skipped), Knip, canary, production build, build purity, 316 Playwright passes (24 skipped) on port 3000, design census and line census. PS_DATA_DIR and HERMES_HOME were isolated under .gate. Native and digest-pinned Linux Docker planted-secret controls passed; a redacted Linux full-history scan with default traversal reported zero unignored findings. The strict isolated historical control found the same ten exact candidates without an ignore file. Implementation commit ccd7c103 was pushed to dev. Hosted push CI 36458230201, PR CI 36458237763, push Gitleaks 36458230381 and PR Gitleaks 36458237777 all completed successfully. Both hosted secret-scan jobs executed branch fetch, full-history Docker scan (1,621 reported patches), Gitleaks action v8.30.1 and planted-secret control. PR CI passed full E2E, both native builds, Docker, install, real Hermes and acceptance. Push CI skipped full E2E and acceptance by existing event condition; every job it ran passed.
mutation: The clean committed-tree sweep against ccd7c103 killed all three T-0180 mutants by assertion failure: disabled default rules, a broad tests exclusion and unpinned hosted scanner. The unmodified controls passed before and after; restoration left dev clean. No NOT-APPLIED, INEFFECTIVE or SURVIVED result occurred.
deviation: Independent review found two issues after the first green local gate, so the original oracle stayed frozen and a different author added a separate red-first four-case amendment. The workflow was corrected and the entire ten-step gate reran green on the final tree. The local Gitleaks patch count remains lower than Git's non-merge commit count, and three expired July 25 alerts cannot be attributed to surviving reports. The workflow covers current fetched remote branch history plus the PR checkout, not deleted, unreachable or other PR-only refs. No candidate was silently declared a real credential or a historical alert cleared.
